Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.utils.switcher

Class WindowSwitcherPlugin

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.utils.switcher.WindowSwitcherPlugin
All Implemented Interfaces:
SceneManagerPlugin
public class WindowSwitcherPlugin extends Object implements SceneManagerPlugin
The Alt+Tab-style window switcher for the native 3D desktop: the plugin counterpart of the 2D/Swing desktop's WindowCyclerOverlay, and the third window-management feature ported off the taskbar (after WorkspacePlugin and WindowSnapPlugin). GlassyTaskbar is not touched.

The plugin keeps the live set of open Frame3Ds through Frame3DAddedEvent/Frame3DRemovedEvent and their MRU order through Component3DToFrontEvent, feeding both into a WindowCycler<Frame3D> — the very same pure MRU/cycle model the 2D desktop uses, generalized over the window type rather than duplicated. A trigger keystroke opens a cycle session and steps the highlight; a short idle timer then commits the selection by posting a Component3DToFrontEvent on the highlighted frame.

Why Ctrl+Alt+Tab, not Alt+Tab

In development mode the desktop is an ordinary window under the host window manager, which grabs Alt+Tab (and Super+Tab) before it ever reaches this JVM. The Ctrl+Alt prefix is the plan's binding for the 3D switcher and is not taken by the common host window managers. Committing is not a keystroke: detecting the release of the modifiers is unreliable, so (exactly like the 2D overlay) the selection commits on a 600 ms idle timer once the user stops pressing the trigger. See WindowSwitcherKeys for the full rationale.

A carousel of live window miniatures

The overlay is a CDViewer-style circular carousel (WindowCarousel3D): one card per open window, the selected window seated at the front and enlarged, each card textured with that window's own live content. It cannot reuse Frame3D.getThumbnail() — that Thumbnail is a single-parented Component3D already owned by the taskbar, so reparenting it onto the HUD would steal it from the bar — so a WindowThumbnailSource shares the window SwingNode's live texture instead, with a titled glass card as the fallback for pure-3D apps. Besides the Ctrl+Alt+Tab cycle, the user can spin the carousel with the mouse wheel and click a card to commit that window straight away.

getPluginRoot() returns null: the switcher is parented to the HUD layer rather than the scene root, so it inherits the layer's perspective-compensated front pose. When DesktopHudPlugin is not running the overlay is skipped with a warning, but the MRU tracking and the keystrokes still work (commit still brings the selected frame to front).
